content.text: Criminal Defense LawyerThe criminal justice system is not always as “just” as we’d like it to be – and this is especially true in Louisiana. If you’ve been accused or charged with a crime, the most important first step you can take is to contact an experienced Louisiana criminal defense attorney who will protect your interests and guide you through the legal system. The Jones Law Partners criminal defense attorneys have years of experience defending the rights of our community members, and we will be there for you every step of the way to fight for your rights and advocate for you. Mr. Jones and his team were great to me. They were very responsive to any questions I had and responded in a timely manner. ~ Angie Criminal Defense Law in LouisianaEvery criminal case is different, and most people aren’t familiar with the criminal court system or what options are available to people who are accused of a crime.If you’ve been accused of a crime that carries serious penalties like stiff fines or even jail time, you need a criminal defense attorney at your side. Our Jones Law Partners Louisiana criminal defense attorneys will sit down with you and explain in detail what options you have based on the details of your unique situation. For example, in some cases a plea deal might be the best option, but in other cases fighting the charges in court may be the better option. Our attorneys can advise you on the best course of action for your specific situation. How a Louisiana Criminal Defense Lawyer Can Help The criminal justice system often treats people more like numbers or profit margins rather than people. When you work with The Jones Law Partners, you’ll meet with a real Louisiana criminal defense lawyer who will treat you with the dignity and respect you deserve. Here's how we'll help: 1Walking You Through The Legal Process:It’s very common for people who are facing criminal charges to wonder what comes next and how long the legal process will take. There are a lot of variables that can affect how your case proceeds. Once you sit down with one of our Louisiana attorneys to discuss all of the elements of your case, we will be able to explain in detail the legal process and all of your options going forward. You will know what to expect during each step in the process, and our Jones Law Partners will be by your side every step of the way as we fight the charges against you.2Creating A Strategy For Your Case:Whether you’re facing misdemeanor or felony charges, criminal charges can result in either penalties or jail time or both. That’s why you need a legal strategy that takes into account the details of your case and paves the way for a defense that will protect your rights and give you the best possible chance of vindication. With years of experience in criminal cases in Alexandria and throughout Louisiana, our criminal defense attorneys can work with you to create a strategy that will offer the best chance of winning in court.3Fighting For You In CourtCriminal cases may be settled out of court and never be argued in front of a judge. But if your criminal case does go to trial, you need to have an experienced trial attorney with experience in Louisiana criminal law fighting for you to give you the best chance of defending your rights and clearing your name. Our Jones Law Partners criminal defense attorneys have the experience and knowledge to fight for you in court if it's necessary. Get the Defense You Deserve with The Jones Law Partners You don’t have to go through this process alone. Having the right advice and the right Louisiana criminal defense lawyers fighting alongside you will make the process a lot less overwhelming. If you’re facing criminal charges, call The Jones Law Partners today so that we can help you plan your next steps and protect your good name. Contact Us
